FalknerIntroText:
I'm FALKNER, the
VIOLET #MON GYM leader!

People say you can
clip flying-type

#MON's wings
with a jolt of electricity…

I won't allow such
insults to bird #MON!

I'll show you the
real power of the

magnificent bird
#MON!
FalknerWinLossText:
…Darn! My dad's
cherished bird #MON…

All right.
Take this.

It's the official
#MON LEAGUE ZEPHYRBADGE.
FalknerZephyrBadgeText:
ZEPHYRBADGE
raises the attack power of #MON.

It also enables
#MON to use

FLASH, if they
have it, anytime.

Here--take this
too.
FalknerTMMudSlapText:
By using a TM, a
#MON will

instantly learn a
new move.

Think before you
act--a TM can be used only once.

TM31 contains
MUD-SLAP.

It reduces the
enemy's accuracy

while it causes
damage.

In other words, it
is both defensive and offensive.
FalknerFightDoneText:
There are #MON
GYMS in cities and towns ahead.

You should test
your skills at these GYMS.

I'm going to train
harder to become

the greatest bird
master!
BirdKeeperRodSeenText:
The keyword is
guts!

Those here are
training night and

day to become bird
#MON masters.

Come on!
BirdKeeperRodAfterBattleText:
FALKNER's skills
are for real!

Don't get cocky
just because you beat me!
BirdKeeperAbeSeenText:
Let me see if you
are good enough to face FALKNER!
BirdKeeperAbeAfterBattleText:
This is pathetic,
losing to some rookie trainer…
VioletGymGuideText:
Hey! I'm no train-
er but I can give some advice!

Believe me!
If you believe, a

championship dream
can come true.

You believe?
Then listen.

The grass-type is
weak against the

flying-type. Keep
this in mind.
VioletGymGuideWinText:
Nice battle! Keep
it up, and you'll

be the CHAMP in no
time at all!
